Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You roll the bottle against the light. A pale thread settles beneath the stopper, and you set it down with sudden care.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Reason
Time
Ten minutes.
Target / range / shape
One accessible potion or mixture.
Type
Skill / Utility

Examine the mixture and make a Reason roll. The mixture remains available afterward.

Weak
Learn its broad purpose and whether using it would harm its intended recipient.
Standard
Learn its effects, use and any contamination or harmful additive.
Strong
Also learn one available treatment for its harmful effects, if a treatment exists.
